violations.description: Preventing contamination during storage. — --Food item was not properly protected from potential contamination. Hamburgers and waffles found in the freezer uncovered. Food items should be covered to protect from contamination.

Date marking and disposition of ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food. — --Commercially prepared and packaged egg salad was found in the refrigerated prep table past the expiration date on the container. Food items should not be consumed past the expiration dates on the container. ****Remaining egg salad in container and egg salad sandwiches in cooler should be discarded.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Food contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. The inside of the ice machine was found dirty during inspection. This should be cleaned and maintained clean.--Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. Inside of the microwave was found dirty. This should be cleaned and maintained clean.

Food display and service. — --Potentially hazardous food was not kept at an internal temperature of 41F or below during display or service. Sausage gravy found in bag in top section of refrigerated prep table on top of plastic containers on the right side of the table at 48F. Potentially hazardous foods should be be maintained at 41F or below. **Gravy should be discarded.
